title: adjudications
description: harness/adjudications.json: verdicts on specific outputs of specific corpus sentences, or on an input's grammaticality. The citation names the split and the line ('dev 17: the sentence .'), exactly as the baseline keys it; check_schemas verifies it against the pinned corpus.

verdict.description: right: natural Japanese that says what the English says, plain or polite; wrong: anything else — the meaning is lost or changed, a form or particle is ungrammatical, the giving or receiving verb points the wrong way, the plain or polite form contradicts a clue in the sentence, or the output is grammatical and faithful but not how it is said; input_ungrammatical: the corpus line's English is not standard. A verdict says that an output is wrong, not why: there is no field for a cause

output.description: the exact output judged (required for right / wrong)

judge.description: who gave the verdict; absent on the verdicts recorded before the field existed
